items.caption: A modern redraw of 事 in the received Shuowen-style seal script, showing a later seal form rather than an ancient inscription specimen.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 事 centered on a white background.
items.selection_reason: This identified seal-script rendering illustrates the received form relevant to the character’s graphic history; it does not establish the disputed identity of the object in earlier graphs.

limitations.text: The image shows a modern vector redraw of a seal-script form, not a directly photographed oracle-bone or bronze specimen. The identity of the object depicted in proposed earlier forms remains disputed.
